building_crystal_plant_2_desc:
New manufacturing techniques enable the mass production of synthetic dilithium crystals that are free from the impurities found in earlier models.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_storm_attraction_center_desc: Por meio da manipulação cuidadosa de forças gravitacionais, estas instalações atraem tempestades cósmicas próximas.
building_advanced_storm_attraction_cente: Centro Avançado de Atração de Tempestades
O conhecimento avançado sobre a energia escura nos permite sobrecarregar cada Centro de Atração de Tempestades e atrair tempestades cósmicas com mais eficiência.
building_storm_repellent_center_desc: Quanto mais longe a tempestade, mais segura estará a população – e todos ficaremos mais tranquilos. Os complexos instrumentos astrometeorológicos destes centros repelem as tempestades que se aproximam.
building_advanced_storm_repellent_center: Centro de Repulsão de Tempestades Avançado
Qualquer tipo de manipulação do espaço-tempo é bem-vinda se mantém nosso mundo livre de tempestades cósmicas. Este centro faz exatamente isso.
building_storm_resistant_production_desc: Este centro de assistência auxilia os esforços locais para anular o impacto de uma tempestade cósmica na produção planetária. Por meio da coordenação e comunicação, o Centro de Assistência contra Tempestades permite a rápida mobilização de equipes de resgate, além de melhorar as condições de comércio em todo o planeta.
building_advanced_storm_resistant_produc: Ao incluir sistemas de controle climático em cada Centro de Assistência contra Tempestades, os efeitos negativos de tempestades cósmicas são reduzidos consideravelmente. Além disso, as equipes de resgate podem ser mobilizadas de forma ainda mais eficiente e as condições do clima local quase não afetam o comércio planetário.
building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute_d: O Instituto Patriótico de Celebração reúne uma coleção de conhecimentos avançados acerca da condição senciente. Aqui, nós capacitamos as pessoas para que cultivem suas próprias tempestades interiores enquanto evitam o encanto sedutor da crueldade da Convenção.
building_astrometeorology_observation_ce: Fazendo uso de sensores delicados, este centro de observação estuda as diversas condições ambientais para ampliar a nossa compreensão do universo natural.
building_storm_summoning_theater_desc: Em um festim de arte e tecnologia, os passos apaixonados de nossos Dançarinos da Tempestade ajudam a atrair tempestades cósmicas.
building_storm_holo_theater_desc: Transmitido para todo o planeta e além, o Holossalão da Tempestade da Tempestade expande o alcance de nossos deslumbrantes Dançarinos da Tempestade.
building_storm_grand_theater_desc: Materializando uma conquista artística e tecnológica de última geração, estes grandes teatros fornecem o palco perfeito para a maior das danças.
building_affluence_center_desc: Este centro materializa os desejos mais excêntricos com facilidade e de imediato.
building_fe_dome_desc: Estas redomas suspensas por meio de nulificações gravimétricas transcendem as limitações físicas, enquanto sistemas avançados de suporte à vida atendem às necessidades da população com perfeição.
building_fe_stronghold_desc: Este monumental complexo de defesa planetária conta com inúmeros arsenais e diversas camadas de proteção. As montanhas do planeta ruirão antes de suas defesas serem penetradas.
building_master_archive_desc: Este repositório abriga o conhecimento de várias eras galácticas, porém a capacidade de operar seu sistema de recuperação arcano foi perdida. Os fragmentos de dados extraídos são inestimáveis.
wildlife_ranch_desc: Vivemos em parceria com as criaturas nativas, tomando o mais extremo cuidado com a proteção de seus habitats e com o crescimento sustentável de suas espécies.
wildlife_ranch_2_desc: O gerenciamento cuidadoso de ecossistemas melhora as condições para as criaturas nativas e facilita as atividades de criação.
wildlife_ranch_3_desc: Uma vasta instalação onde animais vagam livremente. Eles recebem luxos e confortos para maximizar a qualidade dos recursos que fornecem.
hunting_grounds_desc: Um complexo de treinamento usado para promover a excelência das técnicas de caça. Desde modernas armas energéticas até implementos marciais tradicionais, destreza e habilidades inigualáveis são necessárias para abater predadores temíveis e recuperar seus troféus.
hunting_grounds_2_desc: Uma instalação de treinamento e monitoramento que fornece as condições ideais para a fauna local. Tecnologias de mapeamento térmico ajudam a identificar rastros animais recentes e obter troféus de qualidade.
hunting_grounds_3_desc: Uma vasta expansão que comporta grupos de caça planetários em escala maciça. Equipados com armas e acessórios de rastreamento da mais alta qualidade, os caçadores recebem um treinamento de alto nível para maximizar a quantidade e qualidade das presas abatidas.
wildlife_sanctuary_desc: Uma reserva natural protegida onde animais selvagens são estudados em seus habitats nativos. Salvaguardas são estabelecidas para impedir a instabilidade populacional ou a disseminação excessiva de doenças. O próprio estudo dessas criaturas é um esforço acadêmico louvável, mas também nos ensina conhecimentos cruciais sobre a nossa própria natureza.
wildlife_sanctuary_2_desc: As criaturas aqui recebem cuidados de forma individual, e suas dietas e necessidades médicas únicas são fornecidas com o mínimo de perturbação aos seus habitats naturais. Ecossistemas especializados permitem a propagação e reintrodução de espécies ameaçadas.
wildlife_sanctuary_3_desc: Os animais aqui são monitorados e tratados por meio de uma infraestrutura cuidadosamente projetada para parecer invisível. Pesquisadores são proibidos de interferir com o comportamento natural dos espécimes, garantindo uma coleta de dados de pesquisa da mais alta qualidade.
xeno_geology_holomuseum_desc: Um instituto multifacetado dedicado à preservação e estudo de formações minerais e pedras preciosas.
aesthetic_wonders_holomuseum_desc: Aqui, as maravilhas da galáxia podem ser apreciadas com calma.
galactic_history_holomuseum_desc: Um arquivo educativo onde são exibidos itens que representam eventos importantes para a história da galáxia.
building_augmentation_center_desc: Uma construção preparada para a instalação de implantes cibernéticos. Uma mistura de shopping center, centro cirúrgico e oficina.
building_cyberdome_desc: Sedia eventos de ciberesportes violentos com atletas melhorados para entreter os cidadãos do império. Gladiadores, atletas e velocistas aprimorados competem pelo nosso favor até serem danificados ou mortos.
building_power_plant_1_desc:
Fusion generators are a reliable, clean, and efficient energy source that can be found on almost every warp-capable planet in the galaxy. They provide a large amount of energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_2_desc:
The power hub is a managing station for local power stations, increasing local efficiency in connected stations and thus increasing their power output.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_3_desc:
The planetary energy grid now spans the entire world, with transmitters and cabling extending across continents. Power plants are linked in unison allowing shortages in one area to be shored by another.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Power Plant.
building_power_plant_4_desc:
This complex utilises advanced algorithms to manage and control energy generation on all our planets, allowing our power stations to function more efficiently and thereby generate more energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Power Plant.
building_hydroponics_farm_1_desc:
Hydroponic farms artificially regulate and monitor the agricultural industry. By utilising autonomous crop rotation we can ensure that the environment is used effectively and responsibly.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Hydroponic Farm.
building_hydroponics_farm_2_desc:
Employing autonomous systems and advanced robotics to cultivate crops enhances agricultural efficiency. Meticulous processes ensure optimal yields, revolutionising food production for distant worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Hydroponic Farm.
building_hydroponics_farm_3_desc:
The growth of genetically enhanced crops and protein in large biofarms allows for a substantial increase in food production.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Hydroponic Farm.
building_hydroponics_farm_4_desc:
Energy intensive controlled climates have been created that are perfect for the growth of high yielding crops and protein, which maximises the production of food in a limited space. 

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Hydroponic Farm.
building_mining_network_1_desc:
After centuries of primitive and dangerous mining methods we have now developed technologically-advanced mining techniques, that will enable us to extract resources from planets by safe and effective means.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_2_desc:
Advances in shielding and harmonic suppressors allow the construction of thermal boreholes that delve deep within the crust allow for further resource extraction.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_3_desc:
Large complex designs allow for large thermal boreholes deep into the crust of the planet, allowing previously inaccessible pockets of rich mineral material to be harvested and mined.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Mining Network.
building_mining_network_4_desc:
Particle impellers draw the minerals directly from the mantle of the planet, separating and segregating the rich minerals from the useless rock material.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Mining Network.
building_colony_shelter_desc:
Este prédio é o prédio do governo central. É usado agora como sede central do próprio planeta. As primeiras cidades, sem dúvida, irão prosperar se permanecerem próximas ao coração administrativo do planeta. Este prédio é o equivalente ao nível 1 £ Capital Facility.

Sede Planetária
building_primitive_farm_desc: Chácaras primitivas trabalhando no solo em troca de colheitas ínfimas.
building_primitive_factory_desc: Fábricas primitivas e ineficientes cuspindo poluição enquanto produzem bens.
building_primitive_mine_desc: Túneis de mineração primitivos que serpenteiam pelo solo.
building_primitive_power_plant_desc: Uma usina de energia primitiva e um tanto duvidosa que usa carvão ou energia atômica arcaica, envenenando a atmosfera.
building_crude_huts_desc: Abrigos primitivos feitos de pedra, argila ou quaisquer outros materiais disponíveis.
building_primitive_dwellings_desc: Estas pequenas construções fornecem uma quantidade mínima de abrigo, mas estão protegidas contra o tempo.
building_stone_palace_desc: Palácios primitivos construídos de pedra, onde a elite local reside.
building_primitive_capital_desc: As construções de capitais regionais dos diversos Estados-Nação que habitam este mundo primitivo.
building_urban_dwellings_desc: Selvas de concreto aglomeradas e geralmente poluídas.
building_pre_ftl_radio_telescope_desc: Uma matriz de radiotelescópios que estão em busca de vida alienígena inteligente.
building_hive_crude_huts_desc: Por conterem os materiais mais simples e mais fáceis de manipular, estes ninhos quase nem servem para proteger os drones do frio durante a noite.
building_hive_primitive_dwellings_desc: Começando a otimizar o espaço disponível, este tipo de construção em formato de hexágono pode abrigar o que, de certa forma, seria chamado de colônia.
building_hive_stone_palace_desc: Em um mundo em que você precisa competir com a sua própria espécie para sobreviver, ter paredes de pedra é uma vantagem.
building_hive_primitive_capital_desc: Um típico ponto central do continente que abriga colmeias que disputam o controle deste mundo.
building_hive_urban_dwellings_desc: Uma solução útil para abrigar drones quando estão no ciclo de descanso. Há entradas e saídas separadas para otimizar o processo de recarga da colmeia.
building_hive_primitive_factory_desc: Fábricas primitivas e ineficientes cuspindo poluição enquanto produzem bens.
building_hive_primitive_mine_desc: Túneis de mineração primitivos que serpenteiam pelo solo.
building_hive_primitive_power_plant_desc: Uma usina de energia primitiva e um tanto duvidosa que usa carvão ou energia atômica arcaica, envenenando a atmosfera.
building_hive_primitive_farm_desc: Chácaras primitivas trabalhando no solo em troca de colheitas ínfimas.
building_fe_xeno_zoo_desc: Uma reserva altamente sofisticada que mantém perfeitamente o habitat natural das espécies alienígenas 'preservadas'.
building_paradise_dome_desc:
A fully enclosed habitation dome with a self-contained ecosystem, a veritable private paradise for those rich or fortunate enough to live there. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
building_great_pyramid_desc: Uma pirâmide construída pela população local para agradar uma divindade descida dos céus.
building_war_factory_desc:
An extremely sophisticated military drone production facility capable of rapidly analysing strategic information and accordingly altering both the hardware and firmware of its drones. Thankfully inert, this facility is currently being rigorously studied by our scientists to glean insights into autonomous construction techniques and adaptive A.I. algorithms.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_automation_2_desc: Aqueles que já estiveram por lá dizem: \"Otimiza\".
building_automation_technician_1_desc:
Uma placa na parede diz: \"Automatiza\".

Esta construção automatizará uma parcela de empregos de Technician e Technician Drone.
building_automation_technician_2_desc:
Aqueles que já estiveram por lá dizem: \"Otimiza\".

building_automation_miner_1_desc:
Uma placa na parede diz: \"Automatiza\".

Esta construção automatizará uma parcela de empregos de Miner e Mining Drone.
building_automation_miner_2_desc:
Aqueles que já estiveram por lá dizem: \"Otimiza\".

building_automation_farmer_1_desc:
Uma placa na parede diz: \"Automatiza\".

district_city_desc: A city is a large settlement with extensive systems for housing, transportation, sanitation, utilities, land use, and communication.
district_mining_desc: Multistory facilities entirely dedicated to the production of industrial material.
district_mining_uncapped_desc: Vast production nodes can produce an almost unlimited amount of material.
district_farming_desc: Zoned for farming, these districts provide food.
district_generator_desc: Entertainment, commodities, services and everything else one could possibly buy with Latinum is found here.
district_nexus_desc: Distritos centralizados dos quais drones são controlados e enviados para seus trabalhos.
building_private_shipyards_desc:
The creation of smaller private vessels for usage by the civilian populace is a lucrative business for those with the knowledge to build them.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_military_contractors_desc:
Private military contractors can undertake security contracts for those with the credits or latinum to purchase their services.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_commercial_forum_desc:
A regular economic forum where business can meet to discuss policies or arrange large deals. Holoprojectors and subspace communications arrays make this a desirable location.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_private_mining_consortium_desc:
A consortium of smaller mines which has banded together in the search for rare materials. Workers rights and safety issues are of secondary concern compared to profit.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_food_conglomerate_desc:
Smaller farmers and producers are joined together under this conglomerate, bringing the benefits of massive purchasing power and volume discounts to those that would otherwise be unable to do so.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_public_relations_office_desc:
Handling public relations and the media is vitally important for marketing concerns, as well as handling any undesirable outcomes that may result from dangerous business practices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_xeno_tourism_agency_desc: Esta agência corporativa promove uma grande variedade de atrações turistas interestelares, bem como oferece pacotes de emprego e bônus de contratação para emigrantes em potencial interessados em se mudarem para o espaço corporativo.
building_underground_chemists_desc:
The more dangerous stims and illicit substances across the galaxy are too short lived to travel across the stars, and require networks of local laboratories where they can be produced.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_underground_clubs_desc:
Large underground clubs are a breeding ground for excitement, miscreants and customers of more illicit goods.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_pirate_haven_desc:
Selling the goods procured by piracy is just one of the services offered at this 'freeport'. With no questions asked, and no taxes paid, this is a haven for smugglers and pirates alike.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_smuggling_rings_desc:
Laws, taxes and tariffs can be avoided by the more wily merchants who traverse the stars. If there is a demand for a product, the smugglers can fill it.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_foundry_1_desc:
Foundries are large scale manufacturing centres using exceeding high temperatures to blend regular metals and elements together to form strong alloys, which are often used in the construction of space faring vessels.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_2_desc:
Forges capable of producing temperatures in excess of a million kelvin allow for the large scale blending of hull materials into stronger alloys.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_3_desc:
The creation of large pressure forges containing a vast roiling amount of raw materials allows for the mass production of elements into stronger alloys.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_1_desc:
Mass-produced consumer goods ranging from furniture to aircars are created in factories and manufacturing plants within the industrial centre, ready for distribution across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_2_desc:
Fabricating the goods required in a warp-capable society can only be achieved through the use of complex machinery and an automated workforce in order to meet the requirements of a large population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_3_desc:
The high precision required for complex civilian tools and goods can now be met by the introduction of nano-chambers, which allow the finest details to be created quickly and then mass produced.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_research_lab_1_desc:
The data node processes and stores information relevant to current events, distributing the information and allowing research to be undertaken by other nearby nodes.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_research_lab_2_desc:
The Long-Term Data Archive processes and stores information relevant to current events via sophisticated multilayered systems. It is also distributing the information and allowing research to be undertaken, in addition to providing a backup server for nearby data nodes.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_research_lab_3_desc:
The Planetary Data Storage system acts as a central database for the whole planet. It coordinates the work of the Long-Term Data Archives and ensures information is distributed smoothly across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_luxury_residence_desc:
Intricately designed residential towers with luxurious apartments. Providing state-of-the-art facilities with luxuries that are unparalleled. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Facility.
building_drone_storage_desc:
A storage area for Drones to undergo maintenance. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Facility.
building_drone_megastorage_desc:
With the latest upgrades, while undergoing maintenance a portion of Drones' power-generation can be re-directed to the grid. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
holding_garrison_desc: Uma guarnição criada para supervisionar os executores locais. É ocasionalmente reforçada por batalhões militares em situações mais graves.
holding_orbital_assembly_complex_desc: Uma construção alta e repleta de longas linhas de montagem que cria tudo o que alguém possa sonhar.
holding_orbital_assembly_complex_effect: Aumenta os efeitos de módulos no Anel Orbital do planeta.
holding_propaganda_office_desc: Um ministério que supervisiona as religiões, notícias e grupos de interesse político locais. Com a cutucada certa, tudo corre um pouco melhor.
holding_satellite_campus_desc: Um grande campus onde pesquisadores locais e cientistas estrangeiros podem se reunir para compartilhar ideias e fazer experimentos.
holding_emporium_desc: Grandes centros comerciais repletos de mercadorias futurísticas e exóticas de planetas distantes.
holding_aid_agency_desc: Agências fundadas e ocupadas por benfeitores estrangeiros que trazem um pouco da cultura e conhecimento deles para o planeta.
holding_energy_requisitorium_desc: Um ministério que supervisiona a taxação e a cunhagem de créditos energéticos. Geralmente, entra em conflito com a burocracia local.
holding_material_requisitorium_desc: Um ministério que supervisiona a produção, extração e purificação locais de minerais. Ele geralmente assegura as melhores compras de terras e colhe os benefícios para o patrono.
holding_produce_requisitorium_desc: Um ministério que supervisiona a produção agrícola. Além de cobrar um pequeno imposto deste mundo, alguns produtos desaparecem em meio aos processos intrincados e burocráticos desse órgão.
holding_splinter_hive_desc: Uma grande biomassa que produz novos trabalhadores para a colmeia. Apesar de ficar separada da colmeia original, ela está conectada à rede neural.
holding_distributed_processing_desc: Uma estrutura fria que encobre a região local. Quem trabalha aqui se recusa a explicar o que fazem, mas ninguém sai da experiência completamente ileso.
holding_offspring_nest_desc: Neste ninho, uma mente-colmeia estrangeira tem um representante singular que age como um nódulo central para a rede neural dela. Isso permite que ela controle a colônia continuamente.
holding_offworld_foundry_desc: Fornalhas grandes que pertencem a um império estrangeiro. Extraem recursos locais para criar ligas metálicas de alta qualidade.
holding_overlord_vigil_command_desc: Um centro de comando especializado e incumbido de calcular os melhores meios de aumentar as medidas defensivas.
holding_noble_vacation_homes_desc: Um lar longe do lar, este é o lugar perfeito para a elite dominante do Lorde Supremo se acalmar, para que não cause incidentes em casa.
holding_noble_vacation_homes_effect: Cada um dos Castelos Nobres concede +2 de £ Estabilidade na capital do Lorde Supremo.
holding_dread_outpost_desc: O Entreposto do Terror é uma estrutura arcana que produz exércitos reanimados profanos e envia dados falsos para o Lorde Supremo deste planeta.
holding_communal_housing_outreach_desc: Todos têm direito a um lar. É por isso que o Lorde Supremo estendeu o Projeto de Moradia Comunal para este planeta. É uma ótima oportunidade para mostrar aos habitantes o valor do igualitarismo.
holding_reemployment_center_desc: Nunca deixe de explorar um recurso, mesmo que esse recurso seja os mortos do Súdito. Com o Centro de Empregabilidade, o Lorde Supremo pode garantir que os planetas do Súdito estejam sempre repletos de trabalhadores, mesmo que a qualidade do trabalho possa variar.
holding_reemployment_center_effect: 100 novos £ Pops Zumbis serão reanimados em [Planet.reemployment_center_timer]
holding_recruitment_office_desc: Todos devem cumprir um papel. Por isso, o Lorde Supremo está oferecendo treinamento militar em troca de um turno na frota dele. Servir ao exército garante a cidadania.
holding_park_ranger_lodge_desc: O Lorde Supremo tem interesse em coexistir com a natureza e deseja compartilhar essa alegria com o Vassalo dele para garantir que sempre haja pelo menos um pouco de natureza para ser apreciada.
holding_tree_of_life_sapling_desc: O Lorde Supremo coexiste com a Árvore da Vida dele há tanto tempo que não consegue imaginar a vida sem ela. Agora, ele quer compartilhar essa oportunidade com os vassalos dele.
holding_franchise_headquarters_desc: Este conjunto de escritórios permite que a Gestão Corporativa realinhe os interesses do Subsidiário com os do Lorde Supremo dele por meio de exercícios de formação de equipes e treinamentos obrigatórios em todo o planeta.
holding_franchise_headquarters_effect: [trader.GetIcon] [trader.GetNamePlural] produzem -2 de £ Comércio para o Súdito e 1 de £ Unidade para o Lorde Supremo.
holding_experimental_crater_desc: Uma área designada para testar novas naves coloniais asteroidais. Pode não ser o modo mais conveniente de testar as naves, mas terceirizar o processo ajuda o Lorde Supremo a diminuir os gastos com limpeza.
holding_experimental_crater_effect:
Atenção:
     As \"naves\" coloniais em aproximação podem EXPLODIR!
holding_organic_sanctuary_desc: Embora as instalações de tratamento neste planeta sejam mais limitadas do que as nos mundos do Lorde Supremo, os biotroféus dentro delas têm um padrão de vida muito mais confortável do que estão acostumados.
holding_sacrificial_shrine_desc: O grande estudo do ciclo não deve ficar limitado ao Lorde Supremo. A passagem da vida à morte precisa ser explorada pelo Vassalo também.
holding_toxic_bath_desc: Spas Mutagênicos são centros terapêuticos avançados com benefícios comprovados à saúde, mas para alguns, os métodos empregados continuam sendo repugnantes. Cada gota de líquido do banho é mais mutagênica do que a maioria das substâncias proibidas na galáxia.
building_acquisition_plant_1_desc:
Providing supplies across the Dominion requires incredible coordination and depth of supply chain. Dedicated acquisition sites facilitate these activities.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_2_desc:
Increased coordination efforts by the Vorta overseers ensure that the facility can provide additional supplies at key intervals.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_3_desc:
New manufacturing techniques allow for mass acquisition and distribution of supplies across the Dominion Member Worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_acquisition_plant_4_desc:
Replicating the key components speeds up the production of the required supplies which filters through the supply chain.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_alcove_megastorage_desc:
An improved facility providing row after row of Borg Alcoves allowing Drones to regenerate at fast rates. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
building_alcove_storage_desc:
A vast facility providing row after row of Borg Alcoves, allowing Drones to regenerate at fast rates. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Facility.
building_alpha_hub_1_desc:
The transference via uplink node of machine consciousness is a useful tool to ensure units remain unified in their task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_2_desc:
Numerous uplink nodes can meet in a Network Junction, where machine consciousnesses from all across an area can merge and share themselves amongst themselves can ensure unified programming amongst the populace. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_3_desc:
Controlling the vast amounts of machine consciousnesses on the surface of a planet, the system conflux offers a source of unified strength to all who upload themselves to it.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_alpha_hub_4_desc:
The central hub, directly linked to the central processor, where all units can experience the full extent of a collective mind is a great source of unified strength.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_altamid_mine_desc:
This mining facility appears ancient, yet highly efficient. Numerous drone bays and unique adaptation pods beyond common understanding are here, allowing for extremely high mineral production.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_apu_mustering_1_desc:
Newly created personnel units can be mustered within these nodes to receive programming and equipment suitable for their use on vessels or specialised positions.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_2_desc:
Standardised assembly lines utilising common equipment improve the efficiency at which Automated Personnel Units can be outfitted and deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_3_desc:
Predictive algorithms further improve the Automated Personnel Units mustering abilities by predicting and preempting unit utilisation across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_apu_mustering_4_desc:
This facility is the culmination of all APU development. The predictive algorithms of previous tiers have evolved into a fully autonomous system that manages the entire lifecycle of all units. From fabrication to deployment and decommissioning, every APU's purpose is dictated by the centre's infallible calculations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_bank_1_desc:
The storage and transfer of material, whether it's in the form of wealth or distributed via social means, requires a central banking network in order to allow trade to flourish.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_1_logistics_desc:
In the absence of currency, the distribution of scarce resources must be handled within an administrative centre. This ensures supply and demand is met without any requirements of money or wealth.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_2_desc:
Commodities from around the planet are able to be traded at this central location, allowing planetary wide investment opportunities.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_2_logistics_desc:
As the empire grows, so does the complexity of resource management. The Distribution Nexus is a centralised hub that links all planetary supply centres. It uses advanced logistical algorithms to optimise the flow of goods and raw materials, ensuring that every colony's needs are met efficiently and equitably. This facility's precise control eliminates waste and bottlenecks across the entire empire's economy.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_3_desc:
This centre of interstellar business will attract investors from all over the galaxy to invest in our economy, boosting our interstellar energy growth by a significant percentage.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Commercial Building.
building_bank_3_logistics_desc:
Algorithms and automated programmes handle much of the logistics required for predicting supply and demand across the planet within a logistics megaplex, resulting in timely resource delivery without any need for commercial entities.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Commercial Building.
building_bolias_bank_2_desc:
The Bank of Bolias in ages past was a monetary institution, dealing with various currency exchange and storage. But with the dawn of interstellar commerce, the growing importance of matter-energy conversion and the dawn of the digital currency, the cunning Bolians have adapted. The Intergalactic Bank of Bolias now deals with the safe storage and delivery of rare goods, and now they have a virtual monopoly in the field.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_bolias_bank_HQ_1_desc:
The Headquarters of the Bank of Bolias is a monetary institution dealing with various currency exchange and storage. The vast digital and physical vaults can only be accessed by key employees and heavy security is posted throughout.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_borg_assimilation_1_desc:
A fully automated facility for converting non-Borg pops into Borg Drones, to bring them and the collective closer to perfection. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Crew Facility.
building_borg_mustering_1_desc:
Drones can be repurposed within these nodes to receive implants and equipment suitable for their use on vessels or specialised positions.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_borg_mustering_2_desc:
Standardised assembly lines can improve the efficiency at which drones can be outfitted with implants and equipment suitable to their purpose before being deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_borg_mustering_3_desc:
Predictive algorithms further improve the efficiency at which drones can be outfitted with implants and equipment suitable to their purpose and deployed.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_borg_mustering_4_desc:
This facility is the culmination of all drone development. The predictive algorithms of previous tiers have evolved into a fully autonomous system that manages the entire lifecycle of all drones. From fabrication to deployment and decommissioning, every drone's purpose is dictated by the centre's infallible calculations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_borg_neutron_enricher_desc:
Using advanced techniques assimilated from several species, Borg facilities can directly and efficiently convert water-ice into usable Deuterium without a noticeable increase in energy requirements.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Facility.
building_capital_2_desc:
Sem um governo planetário, infraestrutura e indústria se tornarão caos e disfuncionais. Portanto, o foco primário de todas as colônias deveria ser estabelecer um centro que garanta a lei, ordem e indústria eficiente.

Complexo administrativo
building_capital_3_desc:
Conforme estabelecemos nossa capital planetária, anunciamos ao resto da galaxia que não seremos mais considerados a linha de frente. Somos uma colônia detentora de direitos, completamente capaz de contribuir com a comunidade galática. 

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.

Capital Regional
building_capital_4_desc:
Este complexo centralizado contém rastreamento de comunicação, bem como armazenamento de memória de ponta, processador de energia, e sistemas de display. A estrutura é capaz de coletar, armazenar e analisar informações de todo o planeta e corpos orbitais ao redor, servindo como eficaz centro governamental.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.

Grande Capital
building_capital_5_desc:
Este complexo é mais que apenas uma sede do governo. Simboliza nossas conquistas, conquistas as quais uma vez existiram apenas em ideias do nosso passado e na cabeça de nossos sonhadores. É o coração pulsante de nossa civilização, o centro da onde a cultura se espalha. Este complexo e o mundo onde se localiza é a joia de nossa coroa. 

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.

Capital do Sistema
building_capital_confederacy_3_desc:
The Presidents Palace is a symbol of Human power over the galaxy. We are announcing to the rest of the galaxy that we are the rightful rulers of the galactic community.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_capital_confederacy_4_desc:
This centralised complex contains communication and tracking hardware, as well as cutting-edge memory storage, processing power, and display systems. The structure is capable of collecting, storing, and analysing data from all across the planet and nearby orbital bodies, serving as a highly effective symbol of Human might.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_capital_confederacy_5_desc:
This complex is the envy of all lesser species. It is a symbol of the power of humankind and all it dominates, achievements that once existed only in the fiction written in our past and in the mind's eye of our dreamers. It is the beating heart of our civilisation, the centre from which our culture spreads. This complex and the world it rests upon is our crown jewel.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_capital_terran_3_desc:
O Palácio Imperial é o símbolo do poderoso Terran. Estamos anunciando ao resto da galáxia que somos os governantes por direito da comunidade galática.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.

Palácio Imperial
building_capital_terran_4_desc:
Este complexo centralizado contém rastreamento de comunicação, bem como armazenamento de memória de ponta, processador de energia, e sistemas de display. A estrutura é capaz de coletar, armazenar e analisar informações de todo o planeta e corpos orbitais ao redor, servindo como eficaz centro governamental.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.

Complexo Imperial
building_capital_terran_5_desc:
Este complexo é mais que apenas uma sede do governo. Simboliza conquistas de Terran, conquistas as quais uma vez existiram apenas em ideias do nosso passado e na cabeça de nossos sonhadores. É o coração pulsante de nossa civilização, o centro da onde a cultura se espalha. Este complexo e o mundo onde se localiza é a joia de nossa coroa. 

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.

Mega-Complexo Imperial
building_central_plaza_1_desc:
A monument to commemorate those who have contributed to our great civilisation, as well as collections of achievements that citizens can admire and aspire to.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_2_desc:
A plaza which utilises culture to stimulate to the citizens and feelings of togetherness and of national unity.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_3_desc:
Large areas, perfect for gatherings and exchanges of local cultures allow for a place where our population is united.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_4_desc:
Spacious areas, especially engineered for gatherings and to promote and stimulate local cultures in order to unite people.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_confederacy_1_des:
A monument to commemorate the triumphs of the power of the Human spirit, as well as collections of achievements that citizens can admire and aspire to.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_confederacy_2_des:
A large site dedicated to the triumphs of the Confederacy, which utilise sharp architecture and cultural sites to stimulate feelings of loyalty amongst the citizens and feelings of fear to any dissenters.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_confederacy_3_des:
Large areas filled with monuments to Human triumphs, perfect for gatherings and marches which promote loyalty and obedience to putting humanity first.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_confederacy_4_des:
Spacious areas filled with monuments and sites showcasing areas where the Humankind has triumphed over lesser races, especially engineered for gatherings and to promote and stimulate loyalty and fear in order to unite people behind the banners of the Earth.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_terran_1_desc:
A monument to commemorate the triumphs of the Terran Empire, as well as collections of achievements that citizens can admire and aspire to.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_terran_2_desc:
A large site dedicated to the triumphs of the Terran Empire, which utilise sharp architecture and cultural sites to stimulate feelings of loyalty amongst the citizens and feelings of fear to any dissenters.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_terran_3_desc:
Large areas filled with monuments to Terran triumphs, perfect for gatherings and marches which promote loyalty and obedience to the Empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_plaza_terran_4_desc:
Spacious areas filled with monuments and sites showcasing areas where the Terrans have triumphed over other races, especially engineered for gatherings and to promote and stimulate loyalty and fear in order to unite people behind the banners of the Empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_1_desc:
A large central temple complex, where our citizens can congregate and spread unity amongst themselves, ensuring that every member can appreciate life in their own way.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_2_desc:
With advances in holographic technology the divine could be appreciated literally in a different light. Our citizens can congregate, reflect and enjoy unity amongst themselves, ensuring that every member can appreciate life in their own unique way.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_3_desc:
The Sacred Nexus is a place of spiritual healing, encouragement and enlightenment.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_4_desc:
A great beacon of faith that eclipses all others. Citizens take pilgrimages to the Citadel of Faith from nearby worlds just to experience the spiritual harmony that the temple provides.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_bajor_1_desc:
An ordained altar where the religious can pray to the Prophets allows our citizens to congregate and spread unity amongst themselves, ensuring that every member can appreciate life in their own way.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_bajor_2_desc:
Relics from centuries past make up this ornate shrine to the Prophets, a symbol of the devotion of the Bajoran people to the Celestial Temple.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_bajor_3_desc:
The Temple of the Prophets contains relics and writings from the ancient Bajoran religion, and is a place of spiritual healing, encouragement and enlightenment. An alcove sits empty, where an orb once stood before it was lost.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_bajor_4_desc:
A great beacon of communion with the Prophets that eclipses all others and unites the planet. Alcoves awaiting the Tears of the Prophets line the walls of this vast complex, and the Kai often attends with accomodation for all their followers. Many offworld citizens often take pilgrimages to the Citadel just to experience the spiritual harmony that the temple provides.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_kinshaya_1_desc:
A central location in every gathering within the Holy Order, where the everyman is encouraged to kneel to worship the Holy Order and pledge themselves to its glory.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_kinshaya_2_desc:
Relics from centuries past make up this ornate shrine to the Ministers, a place for the people to worship and pay homage.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_kinshaya_3_desc:
The Temple of the Holy Order contains relics and writings from across the Order, and is a place of spiritual healing, encouragement and celebration of all things Kinshaya. The might of the Holy Order is explained in daily ceremonies.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_central_temple_kinshaya_4_desc:
A glorious ordained building under the watchful eye of the High Ministers themselves. Magnificent services are held with mandatory attendances to celebrate the almighty power of the Holy Order.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_cetacean_centre_1_desc:
The Cetacean Research Centre brings together experts from both land and sea to work on complex tasks and research projects.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_cetacean_centre_2_desc:
The Cetacean Operations Centre tasks the joint Cetacean and land based task forces with tackling ever more challenging assignments at larger facilities.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_chemical_plant_1_desc:
The creation of a new synthetic Ketracel substitute without any of the active ingredients can be produced and refined into a usable solution within this refinery. £ Ketracel-White can be synthesised here.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_city_ship_capital_5_desc:
The central command centre for the entire City Ship, where vital command and control over the vessel is conducted. Every system flows through the bridge, which allocates resources across the entire city ship.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_cloning_capital_2_desc:
Managing the big scale process of cloning needs a specialised cloning centre. Various systems flow through here, allowing planet wide cloning and production.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_cloning_capital_3_desc:
Controlling the vast facilities dedicated to cloning new species requires a gigantic administrative complex. Various systems flow through here, allowing planet wide cloning and production.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_cloning_capital_4_desc:
The capital for every imaginable cloning facility, satisfying the need for clones. At this point a complex is not big enough - it has to be a whole capital. Various systems flow through here, allowing planet wide cloning and production.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_cloning_capital_5_desc:
Combining all knowledge and resources, this place perfected the cloning process. All cloning systems flow through here, allowing planet wide cloning and production.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_collector_heavy_water_1_desc:
Deep-core gas extractors enable vast pockets of Deuterium stored within the ground to be extracted, providing an easy source of heavy water.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_collector_soil_1_desc:
Mineral-rich soil is a common material that is worth its weight in latinum on planets where growing crops is difficult in inhospitable soils. Fertiliser collectors ensure there is a steady supply of the material.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_collector_water_1_desc:
Deep-core ice extractors enable water-ice cores from deep under the ground to be extracted, showing the layout and history of the land under the ice and providing rare early planetary materials.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_commercial_capital_3_desc:
Business transactions and commodity prices flow through the central commercial complexes upon this world. Managing this vast array of information requires highly skilled administrators trained in economics.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_commercial_capital_4_desc:
Scaling the complex to the size of a capital takes business transactions on a global level. Managing this vast array of information requires highly skilled administrators trained in economics.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_commercial_capital_5_desc:
Every financial transaction cumulates in this commercial capital, streamlining business interactions and commodity exchanges globally. Managing this vast array of information requires highly skilled administrators trained in economics.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_compost_1_desc:
By closely monitoring the recycling process with measured inputs of water, air, carbon and other nitrogen-rich materials, we can create a nitrate-rich compost ready for usage.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_coporate_palace_1_ferengi_desc:
The Ferengi Sacred Marketplace is central to the conduct of Ferengi business and several traditional rites, including criminal punishments. It houses several important government buildings. Species from all over the galaxy can conduct trade here under the auspices of the Ferengi government.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Facility.
building_corporate_monument_1_desc:
Brand names known across the galaxy have outlets here, a monument to corporate marketing and success.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_corporate_monument_2_desc:
Large outlets where many corporations have their planetary office are situated within this corporate site, which enjoys low taxation and other perks to attract business.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_corporate_monument_3_desc:
Great conventions and meetings are held within the Corporate Forum, where many of the megacorporations have vast offices and where business is conducted on a daily basis. 

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_corporate_monument_4_desc:
The headquarters of the most wealthy and vast monopolies are situated within the Corporate Nexus, trading billions of credits every day.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_cpm_factory_1_desc:
Chromodynamic Power Modules, or CPMs, can be created in small quantities at the manufactury. The methods used to construct the chromodynamic power modules are simplistic, but they do allow for the promulgation of Automated Personnel Units.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_cpm_factory_2_desc:
Chromodynamic Power Modules, or CPMs, can be created in moderate quantities at the manufactury. The methods used to construct the chromodynamic power modules have advanced since the days of the Creators.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_cpm_factory_3_desc:
Chromodynamic Power Modules, or CPMs, can be created in large quantities at the manufactury. The methods used to construct the chromodynamic power modules are superior than when the Creators first manufactured the original units, and automated life can now be constructed on a mass scale.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_cpm_factory_4_desc:
Chromodynamic Power Modules, or CPMs, can be created in mass at the manufactury. The methods used to construct the chromodynamic power modules have advanced substantially since the days of the Creators, and entire assembly lines now create potential automated life from what was once a purely unique and difficult process.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_crystal_plant_1_desc:
The creation of synthetic Dilithium crystals is an extremely dangerous and energy intensive process, requiring heavy refinement.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_crystal_plant_3_desc:
Harmonisation emitters are utilised in the production of synthetic dilithium crystals, which can now be produced en mass via the harmonisation manufacturing process.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_daystrom_institute_desc:
This institute is the pride and joy of the Mars colonies. Here, our leading experts in various fields collaborate to research and develop the latest and most advanced technologies.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_dilithium_mine_1_desc:
With the expansion of our dilithium industries to this level, the adverse effects on the aesthetic appeal to a society are almost negligible compared to the gains in fleet management capacity, at least almost. Maybe an arboretum could ease the disdain...

Ground-based Dilithium mines produce £ Dilithium.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_dome_1_desc:
A life-support dome allows citizens to wander on hostile worlds without any need for a breathing apparatus or specialised equipment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_dred_assembly_plant_1_desc:
A facility dedicated to the design and production of the dreaded Drednok machines.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_duranium_forge_desc:
Duranium is an extremely strong metallic substance that is used in alloys and plating for hull construction of starships and space stations. The high temperatures of the forge and precision manufacturing techniques allow for the construction of duranium plates.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_embassy_capital_2_desc:
The dedication of an entire world to multispecies interaction requires substantial logistical planning for diplomatic and security requirements, envoys and conferences. The monitoring and control of key environments is vital for those species who prefer certain climates too.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_embassy_capital_3_desc:
The expansion of dedicated facilities and advanced security protocols has transformed the embassy world into a self-contained diplomatic enclave. It is now a secure, neutral ground where a multitude of species can conduct official business under strict security and logistical oversight.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_embassy_capital_4_desc:
A true centre of galactic diplomacy, this conclave is where major negotiations of cosmic importance are hosted. Its sophisticated systems allow for instant translation and legal analysis across countless languages, making it the primary point of contact for new species and alliances.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_embassy_capital_5_desc:
A colossal, elegant spire that dominates the planetary skyline, this building serves as the central hub for galactic diplomacy. Its interconnected chambers and halls house the permanent delegations of countless species, and its very foundation is the repository of all major interstellar treaties and accords.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_enricher_1_desc:
Excess energy can be utilised through an energy intensive neutron enrichment process in order to produce small amounts of Deuterium.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_fabricator_1_desc:
This multipurpose factory can be quickly set up to manufacture a wide range of industrial equipment using advanced materials such as Trellium-D. It can produce items of an enormous size at a remarkable speed. Small buildings can be fabricated on demand.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_fabricator_2_desc:
This facility reduces the need for manual labour in the production of building components by using energy-matter conversion to synthesise the components with advanced minerals such as Trellium-D. Consequently, the cost of construction is significantly reduced.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_factory_4_desc:
Civilian-Grade replicators can produce any product from a wide catalogue of designed items for everyday use. Whilst more complex machinery is reserved for intensive military hardware, any general need can be safely and quickly met by these replicators.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_distillery_1_desc:
This plant produces large quantities of high-quality alcoholic products in a time-consuming and intensive process.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_distillery_2_desc:
New technologies allow for the distillation process to be improved, resulting in less impurities within the final product. These new automated processes also improve the amount of product available at any given time.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_distillery_3_desc:
Quantum molecularisation allows for the aging process to be bypassed entirely during distillation of the spirits, allowing for a more rapid production cycle.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_distillery_4_desc:
Idealised demand prediction software can receive data planetwide about the current trends due to events, festivities, weather or even political climes, allowing products to be marketed and dispatched with real time efficiency.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_undine_1_desc:
This multi-purpose mass can be rapidly configured to build a wide variety of industrial equipment at enormous size and with remarkable speed. Entire small buildings can be grown on demand.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_undine_2_desc:
This facility reduces the need for manual labour in the production of building components in that it uses energy-matter conversion to synthesise the components. Powered by the physic energy of the host organisms.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_undine_3_desc:
This sprawling geo-fabrication hub integrates the planet's very geology into its production cycle. By directly accessing and manipulating planetary resources, the Undine can now synthesise complex building materials on a truly massive scale.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_factory_undine_4_desc:
This nexus is the ultimate expression of the Undine's bio-industrial mastery. It is a unified, gestalt consciousness that links all industrial facilities on the planet into a single, cohesive network. This seamless integration allows for instantaneous materialisation of any structure, no matter its size or complexity.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_ferengi_bar_desc:
This multi-level, vibrant and popular central attraction draws crowds of travelers and inhabitants with its offerings of drink, food, gossip, gaming and fantasy fulfillment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_ferengi_holosuite_desc:
Large complexes house numerous holosuites where patrons can seek out their dreams, whether that means adventure, glory or passion. For a fee of course.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_fighter_hangar_1_desc:
Hidden hangars are located across the planet containing sub orbital fighters that are capable of engaging invading troops.

This £ building will spawn 1 powerful £ defensive army unit per year automatically during peacetime, up to a maximum of 5 units.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_food_fabricator_1_desc:
Simple organic molecules can be synthesised and replicated into large blocks of edible protein. Whilst not tasty, it does allow for a large amount of food to be produced.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_food_fabricator_2_desc:
Improvements to replication technology allow the massless and formless protein blocks to be reformed into facsimiles of regular food almost indistinguishable from the real thing.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_forge_capital_3_desc:
Whilst production is left to the vast foundries and factories upon this world, the administration and logistical needs of the world must be handled within this complex. The raw materials, intermediate stages and final product must all be managed to ensure maximum productivity.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_forge_capital_4_desc:
Industrialisation is in full swing. Even though the majority of this process is behind us, there is still room for improvement, which is not to say that we should not be proud of what we have achieved. This planet is a prosperous place in our empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_forge_capital_5_desc:
We have reached the pinnacle. It took many generations and many resources to reach this point, but it was all worth it. This building is the backbone of the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_foundry_machine_1_desc:
Foundries are large-scale manufacturing centres using exceedingly high temperatures to blend regular metals and elements together to form strong alloys, which are often used in the construction of space-faring vessels.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_machine_2_desc:
Forges capable of producing temperatures in excess of a million kelvin allow for the large-scale blending of hull materials into stronger alloys.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_machine_3_desc:
The creation of large pressure forges containing a vast roiling amount of raw materials allows for the mass production of elements into stronger alloys.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_undine_1_desc:
Organic collectors harvest the biomass using native methods of pulling the mass from the planet and repurposing it for usage.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_undine_2_desc:
Forges capable of producing temperatures in excess of a million kelvin allow for the large scale blending of biomass into stronger materials.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_foundry_undine_3_desc:
Woven nanofibres and organic super-lubricant allows for massive construction mechanisms producing large amounts of ultramodern alloys from the planets biomass.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_acamar_desc:
The Vogt Public Health clinic is an Acamarian hospital which for decades has been free of clan squabbles and interclan politics. Many doctors from each clan undergo training here, before travelling back to their home clan.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_bajor_desc:
The Ilvian Medical Complex is the foremost medical institution on Bajor, utilising the latest technologies to cure all sorts of medical diseases and ailments.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_desc:
The frontier hospital provides space and equipment to heal wounded and ill people. New treatments to counter the bacteria and viruses found on a foreign world begin their development here.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_earth_desc:
Starfleet Medical is a department of Starfleet dedicated to biological research and treatment of its personnel. Based out of San Francisco on Earth, Starfleet Medical oversees all Starfleet medical personnel and facilities, from training to deployment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_sheliak_desc:
The natural silicoid bodies of the Sheliak are tough to damage but also relatively slow to heal. Special regrowth techniques have been developed to heal and cure damaged Sheliak.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_tholian_desc:
The natural crystalline form of a Tholian requires special regrowth methods when damaged in order to undergo healing.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_1_vulcan_desc:
The Vulcan Medical Institute is the foremost medical institution on Vulcan, where Healers attend to learn and hone their craft over decades. Whilst primarily focused on Vulcanoid species, the recent expansion of nearby races has allowed new departments to open.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_acamar_desc:
A health centre where the focus is solely on healing and advancing medical knowledge. It's a place where doctors from all clans receive top-tier training, ensuring a consistent standard of care and expertise that they then carry back to their communities across the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_bajor_desc:
This hub is a significant advancement in Bajoran healthcare, integrating enhanced technologies and expanded facilities to provide even more effective treatments. It continues its mission to address a wide array of medical diseases and ailments with improved capabilities.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_desc:
As medical needs grow, so does the size of the hospital required. A large hospital complex allows for rapid treatment of wounded and ill people as well as large areas suitable for treatments of illnesses and other common ailments.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_earth_desc:
Representing a significant upgrade in Starfleet's commitment to biological research and personnel care, this iteration features enhanced facilities and expanded research capabilities, further refining its oversight of all Starfleet medical personnel and facilities, from advanced training to strategic deployment.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_sheliak_desc:
This centre features enhanced hyperonic radiation chambers, significantly boosting the regenerative capabilities for silicoid forms. These expanded facilities allow for even more rapid and efficient healing, optimising the recovery process for the Sheliak.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_tholian_desc:
This centre enables unprecedented rapid regeneration for the crystalline Tholian body. By generating advanced resonant frequencies, it significantly accelerates the natural healing process, allowing for far faster recovery.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_2_vulcan_desc:
Within this centre, Healers hone their skills to an even greater degree, dedicating decades to refining their craft. While its primary focus remains the care of Vulcanoid species, the recent increase in nearby populations means new departments have been established, allowing for the provision of advanced medical attention to a wider array of races.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_acamar_desc:
This institute now stands as the central nexus for public health across the entire empire. Beyond advanced treatment, it actively analyses empire-wide medical data to predict and preempt major health crises. This leads to the development of cutting-edge preventative medicine and broad public health initiatives, disseminated through its network of highly trained doctors to ensure the well-being and prosperity of every clan and settlement.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_bajor_desc:
This research centre has evolved into Bajor's definitive centre for biomolecular research and restorative medicine. Its laboratories are now at the forefront of genetic therapies, actively developing bespoke treatments designed to reverse even long-standing cellular damage and eradicate previously incurable diseases, aiming to fundamentally enhance Bajoran longevity and vitality.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_desc:
The Psycho-Neural Medical Complex brings advances in the study of the brain to the forefront of medical science. This unlocks the potential for psychological illnesses to be treated fully without the need to resort to drugs or therapeutic care.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_earth_desc:
Starfleet Medical has now become the foremost authority on advanced cybernetic integration and regenerative organ replacement for its personnel. Beyond its core research and treatment, its San Francisco facility houses bespoke surgical suites where cutting-edge prosthetics and bio-engineered organs are developed and integrated, ensuring the long-term operational viability and quality of life for every Starfleet officer, from training through the most demanding deployments.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_sheliak_desc:
This institute has refined hyperonic radiation application to achieve precision cellular reconstruction, allowing for the perfect restoration of any silicoid form. It now specialises in reversing even systemic degradation, ensuring not just rapid healing from injury, but also the indefinite maintenance of optimal structural integrity for the Sheliak, virtually eliminating age-related wear.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_tholian_desc:
This institute has significantly advanced its capabilities, now employing sophisticated resonant frequency arrays that achieve highly efficient and comprehensive restoration of the Tholian body. It can rapidly address complex structural damage and accelerate regeneration far beyond natural rates, providing exceptional recovery and maintaining crystalline integrity through advanced methods.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_3_vulcan_desc:
This institute now stands as a global exemplar for integrated, preventative healthcare, combining the tenets of pure logic with cutting-edge medical science. Healers here are trained to develop highly individualised health protocols, utilising advanced diagnostics to anticipate and pre-emptively mitigate potential ailments across an increasingly diverse patient population. Its methodologies are becoming a cornerstone for long-term well-being, influencing practices far beyond Vulcan's borders.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_acamar_desc:
This facility stands as the pinnacle of Acamarian biological science, transcending mere treatment and prevention. It acts as the empire's supreme hub for genetic engineering and species-wide biological optimisation, dedicated to eradicating hereditary ailments and engineering fundamental resilience into the Acamarian genome itself. Its groundbreaking research and applications ensure not just the health, but the continued evolution and peak vitality of the entire civilisation.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_bajor_desc:
This complex has surpassed all prior medical frontiers, now standing as the universal centre for Bajoran bio-spiritual integration and advanced life-form engineering. Its cutting-edge research delves into the fundamental nature of life and consciousness, developing technologies capable of perfect cellular replication, re-sequencing the genome for ultimate resilience, and even exploring means of sustaining Bajoran essence beyond physical limitation.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_desc:
The Long-Term Medical Holographic Programme brings together advances in the study of enhanced holographic technology with cutting-edge medical science. This unlocks advances for holistic treatments combining technologies remedying both body and soul.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_earth_desc:
This ultimate facility has transitioned into the Federation's paramount authority on sentient species biology and cross-cultural medical ethics. It's a cutting-edge hub dedicated to understanding the intricate biological variations across all known life forms and developing universal medical protocols that respect their unique physiologies and cultural needs. Its research defines the future of interspecies healthcare, ensuring optimal well-being and life-long vitality for all Federation citizens, regardless of their origin.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_sheliak_desc:
This ultimate facility has unlocked the secrets of fundamental silicoid form evolution and multi-state biological adaptation. It’s not merely about healing or maintaining, but about proactively re-engineering the Sheliak structure for enhanced resilience against extreme environmental pressures and previously insurmountable energetic fluctuations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_tholian_desc:
This ultimate institute has mastered the fundamental principles of crystalline biology and energetic re-synthesis. It's now capable of not just healing, but of proactively optimising the Tholian form at a sub-molecular level, enhancing natural resilience, adapting to new environmental stressors, and even facilitating controlled morphological shifts.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_frontier_clinic_4_vulcan_desc:
This ultimate centre has transcended conventional medical science, now operating as the foremost authority on species-wide genetic harmonisation and the perfect optimisation of biological function.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_galactic_exchange_desc:
Commodities, stocks and shares from all over the galaxy are able to be traded at the stock exchange which allows massive quantities of trade to flow through this area.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Commercial Building.
building_galactic_exchange_ferengi_desc:
The Tower of Commerce is the largest and tallest building on the Ferengi Capital as well as the entire Alliance. From the Tower's Chamber of Opportunity, the Grand Nagus presides over the entire financial empire of the Ferengi. It houses the offices of the Ferengi Commerce Authority (on the fortieth floor), including the Board of Liquidators, meetings of the Congress of Economic Advisors, and the Grand Nagus's chambers. The wealth produced and created by these activities in this building is larger than that created by most small interstellar empires.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Commercial Building.
building_galactic_institute_1_desc:
This institution houses the absolute best our interstellar society has to offer. Here the greatest minds gather to bolster our research and development capabilities with new ideas.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_BAJ_desc:
The Bajoran Central Archives is an extensive information repository that is at least 700 years old. The Archives contain communication logs, personnel files, death certificates, and financial and historical records. Interested parties can access the Central Archives to retrieve or verify information for both personal and professional use.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_CAR_desc:
The Cardassian Science Ministry is a government department of the Cardassian Union responsible for scientific research and exploration on behalf of the Cardassians. The department fell under the Cardassian military instead of the civilian government.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_ROM_desc:
The Romulan Ministry of Science is a branch of the Romulan government that is handling technological and scientific matters within the Empire and its colonies.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_TRI_desc:
The Trill Science Ministry is an elite educational institute. Located on the Trill homeworld, the Ministry is a leader in the field of spatial and subspace anomalies.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_VOT_desc:
The heads of the Science caste gather within these facilities, ensuring education and research amongst the Voth complies with Doctrine. The Circle is responsible for many research postings across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_VUL_desc:
The central research institute of Vulcan where many graduates from the Vulcan Science Academy end up serving. The Council is responsible for many research postings across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_galactic_institute_earth_desc:
Tycho Laboratories is a vast institute that provides supplies and researchers to the many science outposts located across the quadrant, as well as assigns research teams to postings at these outposts.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_gene_clinic_desc:
The Genetics Laboratory is at the forefront of genetic research, bringing together studies from across the quadrant to conquer the science of genes.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_generator_water_1_desc:
Purification of water from passing asteroids and comets is of great importance in order to remove any foreign bacterial or mineral presence.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_geothermal_power_plant_1_desc:
Geothermal power plants harness energy generated by geothermal means, which is thermal energy stored within the crust of a planet.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_government_1_federation_desc:
Every Federation Member sends their ambassadors to the embassy complex, where upon matters that affect the entire Federation can be discussed.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_government_1_klingon_desc:
The Klingon High Council meets within these chambers, with the house leaders in charge seeking out a powerbase for their house amongst the empire.
