This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_government_1_romulan_desc:
The Romulan Senate is the main governing body of the Romulan Star Empire, where senators are seated in the Senate chamber. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_hall_heroes_1_desc:
Chambers filled with the rarest artifacts of heroes long past are displayed here. Historians can visit to see a rotating exhibit of legendary warriors.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_heroes_2_desc:
The House of Heroes is a large stately manor where famous Klingon warriors of ages past have their artifacts stored. Key rooms are reserved for the most legendary warriors, and the halls can often be heard to hum with the sound of songs of remembrance.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_heroes_3_desc:
The Forum of Heroes is a large, open site where the artefacts and stories of famous Klingon warriors from ages past are stored. Many warriors gather there to hear tales of the great battles that were fought.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_heroes_4_desc:
The Hall of Heroes is a grand location where statues of famous Klingons are displayed. Those Klingons who commit great deeds are often commemorated via statue here, and many Klingons aspire to have their likeness in the grounds of the hall.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_justice_1_desc:
Sharp edges and security gates mark this building. The prison cells beneath the Chamber of Justice hold important prisoners, whilst above the trials of criminals take place.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_justice_2_desc:
The House of Justice watches over the city with its sharp towers. The prison cells within hold important prisoners, whilst above the trials and executions of criminals take place, exuding a calming presence over nearby settlements.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_justice_3_desc:
The courthouses and cells of the Forum of Justice stand as a testament to the peace that order brings to the planet. Criminals are summarily tried, sentenced and punishment executed within these walls, and the civilian population can feel safe.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_hall_justice_4_desc:
Tales of the screams of prisoners beneath the Hall of Justice circulate amongst the population. Interrogations are undertaken there, and the most politically sensitive prisoners are held there, too. Above ground, however, the Hall of Justice is a beacon of order, providing the population with a sense of security.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_harvesting_centre_1_desc:
Harvesting the organs of those unaffected by the Phage allows for a healthy and productive population. The slaves are less than pleased however.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_harvesting_gorn_1_desc:
Large prison facilities where the Gorn hold those prisoners deemed to be considered prey or breeding sacs.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_harvesting_undine_1_desc:
Slaves of the Undine are rounded up and infested at these centres to produce the biomatter required to continue the great purge.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_high_command_1_desc:
Whilst Central Command is the military authority of the Cardassian Union, the Detapa Council controls the civilian authorities within the Cardassian Union.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_hirogen_worthy_prey_reserve_des:
A vast contained ecosystem where worthy prey can roam free and procreate to create an ideal hunting grounds for the Hirogen.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_holo_assembly_plant_1_desc:
A facility dedicated to the design and production of holographic programs for entertainment, manual labour and the populations needs.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_holodeck_1_combat_desc:
A fighting arena filled with spectator seating and recording devices, allowing fights to be broadcast around the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_1_desc:
The entertainment centre is a place for enjoyment and relaxation, where various skilled entertainers are providing numerous shows.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_1_jemhadar_desc:
This facility serves as a grim stage for the Jem'Hadar's endless quest for martial perfection. Built for the benefit of Dominion allies and subjugated peoples, the arena hosts staged contests where Jem'Hadar soldiers demonstrate their overwhelming superiority against captives from various species.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_1_tsunkate_desc:
Tsunkatse is a popular spectator sport invented by the Norcadians. A local Tsunkatse arena allows for fighters to get together for fantastic spectacles. Touring groups of the finest Tsunkatse fighters can also visit and compete in local games, bringing a personal touch to the audience on each world.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_2_combat_desc:
This expansive, multi-tiered facility expands the spectacle from a simple arena to a gladiatorial pit of immense scale. Built for the masses, these pits feature advanced holographic environments and simulated combat zones, broadcast to a wider audience across the star system.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_2_desc:
The holo-theatre provides plethora of holographic entertainments, which brings to the audience rich sensations. It is hard to tell where the fantasy and reality borders.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_2_jemhadar_desc:
As the Dominion's influence expands, so too does the need for larger spectacles of force. The Jem'Hadar Gladiatorium is a massive, multi-environment arena where squads of Jem'Hadar can demonstrate their tactical and martial dominance against a wider variety of captives and hostile lifeforms. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_2_tsunkate_desc:
This large-scale facility serves as a premier venue for all Tsunkatse games in the region. Colosseums host the most popular and celebrated fighters, who compete in a magnificent spectacle broadcast to a wide audience. Regular appearances from the finest professional fighters bring a powerful sense of prestige and excitement to the local audience.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_3_combat_desc:
This massive, self-contained facility is a monument to combat as entertainment. As the undisputed nexus for all broadcast fighting, The Colosseum hosts the most popular and brutal events in the sector. It is equipped with advanced gravity manipulators and environmental simulators, capable of creating unique and deadly battlefields on demand. Only the most skilled and celebrated warriors have the privilege of competing here.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_3_desc:
The holographic centre brings to the audiences sophisticated holographic multifaceted deep experience. Some people even can lose themselves in holographic worlds, too much enjoyment can cause holo-addiction.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_3_jemhadar_desc:
This sprawling complex is the nexus of the Dominion's martial philosophy. The Dominion Proving Grounds is where the most elite Jem'Hadar units are forged in brutal, high-stakes combat simulations against captured starship crews and military specialists. It is a public monument to the Dominion's might, a chilling reminder that their control extends not only to armies but to the minds and wills of their subjugated populations.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_3_tsunkate_desc:
As a major hub for the professional Tsunkatse circuit, this building is a nexus of interstellar fighting. It is the primary training and competition centre for the galaxy’s most legendary warriors. Live broadcasts of its high-stakes games are viewed by millions, making it a critical source of fame and fortune for the sport's biggest stars.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_4_combat_desc:
A planet-spanning spectacle of violence and entertainment. The Blood Dome is a network of interconnected arenas and combat zones, all broadcasting live to millions of viewers across the galaxy. The dome is the central hub for the greatest warriors, hosting tournaments and events of mythic proportions. No longer confined to single arenas, the combatants must now face off in a series of deadly environments, all under the unblinking eye of a ravenous public.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_4_desc:
The Holosuite Entertainment Centre economises the technology used in a holodeck for mass consumption. By using a modular system of small suites, more patrons can be served at once compared to the larger holodeck.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_4_jemhadar_desc:
The ultimate expression of Dominion power. The Final Crucible is a planetary-scale facility where the Jem'Hadar's superiority is absolute and undisputed. Here, captured fleets are destroyed in staged space battles, and entire armies are meticulously dismantled for the entertainment of the Founders' allies. The sheer scale of this spectacle serves to break the will of any who would dare challenge the Dominion's authority, making it the most potent weapon in their arsenal.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_4_tsunkate_desc:
This legendary complex is the pinnacle of the Tsunkatse circuit. A planet-spanning facility, it hosts the most prestigious tournaments and championship games. The greatest fighters in the galaxy gather here to compete in brutal, high-stakes matches for the ultimate honor and glory, with their every move broadcast to an eager audience across the quadrant.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_undine_1_desc:
Large areas where the Undine gather and test out their combat and physic powers, merging their minds into a single thought to spread knowledge, updates and entertainment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_undine_2_desc:
The Undine gather in large groups to enjoy Psi-Theatre, tales of conquest, and demonstrations of the superiority of biological mass over any threats to the realm.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_undine_3_desc:
Specific centres where the Undine can merge minds with others and the planet around them becoming one with the world via the fluidic space all around.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_holodeck_undine_4_desc:
The Omicron Psi Field economises the technology used in a holodeck for mass consumption. Allowing more Undine to merge mind and soul with the biomass, sharing their consciousness with more of the planet than ever before.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Amenity Building.
building_housing_desc:
This standard housing complex provides functional and secure living spaces for a large population. The design is straightforward, effective and easily replicable, making it a staple of colony worlds and expanding empires alike.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Housing Facility.
building_housing_large_desc:
An incredible feat of engineering that combines efficient, practical residences with carefully maintained idyllic landscapes. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Housing Facility.
building_hurq_curator_collection_desc:
A vast contained ecosystem, along with display areas and exhibitions, houses living museum pieces to display the might of the Hur'Q.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_iconian_gateway_1_desc:
Remnants of the ancient Iconian empire that spanned the galaxy are analysed here in the hopes of providing valuable insight into their technology and culture.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_industrial_replicator_desc:
Using an intensive energy-matter conversion to replicate more complex components, this large scale replicator can create many industrial goods.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_infestation_chamber_1_desc:
This mass conversion centre is a critical hub for the Undine's ongoing infestation efforts. It converts raw organic and inorganic planetary matter into the bio-engineered resources needed to sustain and deploy new Undine Infestors.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_infestation_chamber_2_desc:
This advanced facility focuses on the development of new biological agents and infiltration protocols. Its automated systems rapidly bio-engineer specialised forms of the Undine, known as 'Infestor Prime', to be more resilient and effective at disrupting and subverting enemy populations.

This building is equivalent to a level 6 £ Unity Building.
building_information_broker_desc:
Information is power, and shadow brokers trade their information for power and wealth.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_javonite_jewellery_1_desc:
Shaping and carving jevonite into unique ornate jewelry can only be accomplished with extremely accurate tools.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_jemhadar_mustering_1_desc:
After being birthed, the Jem'Hadar must be outfitted with weaponry and tested to ensure they are a good grow. They can then be assigned to a unit here in the mustering square.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_jemhadar_mustering_2_desc:
Simple firing ranges and combat courses are laid out near the mustering square, allowing units of Jem'Hadar to fight for supremacy and any defective units to be eliminated.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_jemhadar_mustering_3_desc:
Holographic training facilities allow the Jem'Hadar mustering here to engage in simulated assaults on enemy positions to ensure combat efficiency is at peak performance.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_jemhadar_mustering_4_desc:
Advanced weaponry is delivered via quartermasters to units of Jem'Hadar which assemble here, ensuring units of Jem'Hadar are well equipped for battle with the finest weapons and armour.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_kelpien_breeding_ground_desc:
History has taught that delicious species are often hunted to extinction, such as the dodo, giant tortoise and great auk. Terran biologists have learned from this with regards to the Kelpien though, and instead a mass breeding programme where the inferior species are treated as nothing more than cattle has been created, so that we may continue to dine on fine Kelpien long after the species is extinct in the wild. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_kemocite_mine_1_desc:
Kemocite is a mineral that is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. It has many applications depending on its level of refinement, the process of mining and refining requires a special skill and element of risk.

Ground-based Kemocite mines produce £ Kemocite.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_ketracel_white_refinery_1_desc:
To continue to ensure loyalty of soldiers, we genetically engineer them to be dependant on £ Ketracel-White and then provide them with the only source of the substance. Victory is life! And life, in this case, is Ketracel-White.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_lab_engineering_1_desc:
The materials prototype lab is where newly created materials are tested under the harshest conditions by maniacal engineers. 'Do dilithium blend?' It does now. The labs produce a great deal of £ Engineering Research.

Materials Prototype Labs may only be built on planets with an £ anomaly deposit.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_lab_physics_1_desc:
The Supercollider facility is the technological pinnacle of physics research. Its vast array of scientific equipment allows for the study of previously theoretical sciences ranging from Temporal Mechanics to Solar Transplantation. The labs produce a great deal of £ Physics Research.

Supercolliders may only be built on planets with an £ anomaly deposit.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_lab_society_1_desc:
Bio Labs are specialised facilities that include advanced bio-engineering and sculpting tools used by an array of xenobiologists, as well as medical researchers and geneticists. The labs produce a great deal of £ Society Research.

Bio Labs may only be built on planets with an £ anomaly deposit.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_labor_camp_1_desc:
Labour Camps are facilities where prisoners are forced to perform labour, usually under threat of torture or other physical harm. Conditions in the camps are often brutal and hostile, but collaborators help keep them in line.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_machine_fabrication_1_desc:
A massive fabrication complex allowing the creation of goods with ever increasing complexity.

Fabricators allow the player to create a range of possible goods. The fabricated good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_machine_fabrication_2_desc:
Conveyor belts and assembly lines allow for the creation of goods with increased complexity.

Fabricators allow the player to create a range of possible goods. The fabricated good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_machine_fabrication_3_desc:
Replication technology combined with massive assembly lines and an ever increasing complexity of machinery allows for the creation of a massive amount of goods.

Fabricators allow the player to create a range of possible goods. The fabricated good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_maintenance_depot_1_desc:
Workshops where maintenance of machinery and structures is planned, managed, and executed.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_maintenance_depot_2_desc:
Equipped with automated subsystems, the maintenance station allows for a central control hub where maintenance can be coordinated.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Amenity Building.
building_maintenance_depot_3_desc:
A large self contained maintenance complex which ties in to every node and system within a particular area. Failures and suboptimal performance can be managed efficiently.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_mars_perimeter_desc:
The Mars Defense Perimeter is part of the planetary defenses of the Sol system. It is designed to protect the inner planets of the system, and specifically Earth, from intruding hostile starships.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_mars_utopia_planitia_desc: Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, also known as Utopia Planitia Starfleet Yards or Utopia Planitia Shipyards, is a key Starfleet vessel construction and design facility. The facility includes several large drafting rooms for starship design and planetary facilities on the surface of Mars, as well as a number of drydocks and space stations in orbit.
building_memory_alpha_desc:
Memory Alpha was created specifically as an open, undefended centre of knowledge of the Federation and the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.

Alojamento de Animais Selvagens
building_metaphstic_collector_desc:
A large powerful collector of metaphasic radiation. This building opens up a powerful unique edict.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_military_academy_1_desc:
Training volunteers from all over the world improves our soldiers' ability to combat enemy threats.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_2_desc:
The volunteers that are brought to the militia academies are often ill equipped for the dangers of combat. Survival techniques and combat prowess is taught to them here, turning them into a working fighting force.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_3_desc:
Training raw recruits from a civilian life up to a professional standard requires specialist training facilities and equipment, which can be provided in an Army Academy. Training on all types of weaponry from fixed weapon emplacements to vehicular combat is also taught here.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_4_desc:
These academies are founded on the experience we have gained since encountering foreign species. Interspecies physical training and armed training have allowed us to not only enhance our soldiers vitality but also reduce training time.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_1_desc:
This facility serves as a primary local hub for Laikan military operations, handling recruitment, basic training, and essential logistical support for regional defense forces.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_2_desc:
The Laikan Military Academy is an educational institute located on Andoria. This academy trains cadets for service in the Andorian military and provides extension courses through its Department of Foreign Studies to officers from other empires.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_3_desc:
Expanding far beyond its educational roots, the Laikan Military Complex now encompasses advanced research divisions, specialised tactical training units, and large-scale strategic planning facilities. It serves as a comprehensive centre for developing cutting-edge military doctrines and honing the skills of elite forces across all branches.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_andoria_4_desc:
The Laikan Military Nexus stands as the undisputed strategic heart of the Laikan military, a formidable hub where all major command, intelligence, and doctrinal development converge. This pinnacle facility orchestrates galactic operations, pioneers revolutionary combat strategies, and serves as the ultimate wellspring for the most formidable officers and specialised forces in the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_1_desc:
Rather than teaching new hunters with the dangerous and time consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, custom battlegrounds made of cargo and netting can satiate the hunters needs and teach valuable lessons.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_2_desc:
Simple firing ranges and combat courses are part of the hunter training academy, allowing Hirogen to test their might against each other and learn valuable hunting techniques.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_3_desc:
An vast complex filled with trophies of previous hunts, where hunters must learn the weaknesses of a vast array of creatures and sentients in order to improve their effectiveness.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_hirogen_4_desc:
Rather than teaching new hunters with the dangerous and time consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, holographic representations can satiate the hunters needs and teach valuable lessons.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_1_de:
For nine millennia, the Zakdorn have been regarded by potential foes as having the greatest innately strategic minds in the galaxy. Their academies teach the best and the brightest of the sharpest minds, with only the most elite moving on to the Strategos.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_2_de:
A more advanced academy, the Strategium is where the finest minds are honed into practical instruments of interstellar policy. Curriculum here is less about the fundamentals of war and more about the art of winning without firing a shot, through feints, diplomatic maneuvers, and the relentless application of strategic pressure. It is where future admirals learn to think a dozen steps ahead of their opponents.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_3_de:
An elite institution that serves as the final filter before a Zakdornian strategist is given a true command. The High Strategos is a blend of advanced academy and command centre, where cadets are not just taught to lead, but are tested under the most rigorous simulations to ensure their minds and wills are unbreakable. Only the most elite graduate to become a Strategos.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_academy_stragegos_4_de:
The Grand Strategos is the apex of Zakdornian military thought. It is the highest council and the ultimate command centre, where the most brilliant military minds gather to devise grand strategies that can span decades and influence the fate of entire quadrants. To be inducted into the Grand Strategos is to be recognized as one of the greatest military minds in the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_1_desc:
Construction of a local garrison provides the infrastructure required to arm and outfit numerous defensive units. Hardened bunkers and defensive positions allow the defence armies to hold out against superior numbers. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_2_desc:
Improvements to the garrison allow for a more permanent defensive force to be stationed in this system at the Division Headquarters, which is able to respond to any assaults rapidly across the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_3_desc:
The headquarters of our orbital armies is a fortified command and control stronghold, filled with numerous divisions of defensive troops capable of coordinating the defences across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_4_desc:
A massive hardened and purpose built set of structures with large tunnel complexes under the surface allow for entire armies of units to be stationed in this fortress, able to defend against massed assaults by invading armies.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_1_desc:
Active sensors and force field projectors allow this node to project power across a local section of Borg territory.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_2_desc:
Large shield generators mixed with active sensors and forcefield projectors to allow this node to stand as a heavily armoured position.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_3_desc:
Utilising information assimilated from many species, the armoured facilities throughout the planet are outfitted with fixed weapon emplacements and strong shield generators, allowing this node to stand as a central hub for any planetary defense.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_military_camp_borg_4_desc:
Massively armoured structures filled with power nodes mixed with heavy tactical plating allow this complex to stand as a heavily armoured position throughout this area of space. Massive command and control nodes coordinate defenses for many worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_military_capital_3_desc:
A central command and control complex for all military activity upon the surface of the world, with lines of communication to every base, depot and training site.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_military_capital_4_desc:
Most of the army is now stationed here. The site has been expanded further to accommodate the security needs. Risks and dangers are rising in the universe, as is our military.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_military_capital_5_desc:
The sheer size is enormous and it needs to be this way. This site contains not just troops and equipment for many battalions, but also recruitment and training facilities to meet the increased demand.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_monitor_station_desc:
One of Earth's earliest extra planetary installations providing high quality scans of the sol sector and beyond. 

Now used to help coordinate traffic and communications to and from Earth.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_museam_darsay_1: The Hall of Masaka and Korgano
building_museam_darsay_1_desc:
The Halls of Masaka and Korgano celebrate the lost civilisation of D'Arsay, and were built using painstakingly researched and reconstructed techniques. The museum, which stretches over several kilometres, is nestled in a local river valley. The grounds encompass the two main centres of D'Arsay culture: faith and government. These are the Fortress of the Sun and the Palace of the Moon. A park composed of gently meandering paths and various exhibits representing the everyday life of the D'Arsay populace lies between these two edifices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museam_sharien_1_desc:
S'harien was the greatest blacksmith in Vulcan's Forge, creating the best swords on Vulcan. He loved war, hated peace, and therefore despised Surak. At 190 years of age, this unkempt fellow heard that Surak was in the area and pledged to spit on the man. Ten days later, after talking with Surak, he renounced all violence and set about destroying all his swords. However, so beautiful were his wares, that Surak himself begged S'harien to stop his destruction and to retain the weapons.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museum_1_desc:
Storage and preservation of items important to our cultural heritage has a high priority, and a museum designed for this purpose is the ideal focal point.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_museum_2_desc:
Hur'Q armazena o conhecimento coletivo de todos espécimes biológicos dentro cofres enormes neste mundo, com enclaves fechados onde espécimes biológicas podem ser estudadas e coletadas livremente.

Complexo do Museu Central
building_nanite_factory_1_desc:
The production of nano scale machines known as nanites requires precision material and a stable environment in which to operate, hence the optimal approach is to have it located in zero gravity.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_2_desc:
Large centrifuges and environmentally pristine bays allow for the replication of nanites in larger volumes than were previously available.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_3_desc:
Self replicating nanites operate at a submolecular level to create and reproduce themselves over time within these large chambers, ready to be utilised at a moments notice.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_nanite_factory_4_desc:
Vast compressed bays, where nanites are stored so close together they are visible to the naked eye, are outfitted to the foundry with new construction techniques allowing waste materials to be reconstituted into usable material. The high precision results in almost zero waste or discarded nanites due to production failures.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_naval_HQ_1_borg_desc:
The direct uplink to the harmonisation computers on the Unimatrix allows for the rapid dissemination of key Borg protocols to certain drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_breen_desc:
The Confederate Command is responsible for overseeing Breen military and civilian organisations, as well as the Breen's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_cardassian_desc:
The true heart of the government, Central Command, controls all naval and troop movement within the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_confederacy_desc:
The Corp ensure that humanity takes its rightful place at the centre of the galaxy. Only the most successful and loyal officers are allowed to serve the Confederacy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_hirogen_desc:
An advanced dome filled with ravenous deadly creatures, where hunters must fight in teams just to survive - with only the best leaders able to survive the onslaught.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_klingon_desc:
The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle. Drunken celebrations are held for a full day before the induction itself, which is part of the ceremony as an endurance test.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_norcadian_desc:
Vast interspecies facilities exist amongst broadcasters as the requirement for new crews, fighters and new officers increases exponentially. Holographic training allows for simulated scenarios to take place, whilst above, the key broadcasters conduct business.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_romulan_desc:
The central headquarters of the Romulan navy serves as the vital strategic brain of the Romulan Star Navy. From this central command nexus, all major fleet movements, tactical deployments, and intelligence-driven operations across the Empire are meticulously orchestrated to ensure Romulan dominance and security.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_sona_desc:
Son'a Command is the operational organisation established by the Son'a followers for their military forces they constructed after being banished from Ba'ku.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_starfleet_desc:
Essential training of new cadets and officers for service on Starfleet's vessels begins here. The command and control of Starfleet is also conducted from the highest offices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_terran_desc:
Enlistment and loyalty testing of new cadets and officers begins here, with only the most loyal or the most ruthless surviving until graduation for service on the Imperium's vessels. The command and control of the Imperial Starfleet is also conducted from the highest offices.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_undine_desc:
When the Undine feel that their realm and their biological supremacy are under threat, they assemble a group of warriors ready to eliminate the weak.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_HQ_1_vulcan_desc:
The High Command is responsible for overseeing Vulcan military and civilian organisations, as well as Vulcan's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_naval_depot_1_desc:
Maintaining a large fleet requires logistics. Stores of goods, distributed throughout the realm, are indispensable to the function of a sovereign navy.

Naval Supply Depots can only be built on Strategic Location deposits.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_north_ranch_desc:
The vast steppes of the North Star colony are prime ranching grounds for wildlife.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_north_saloon_desc:
The primary social hub of the North Star colony, the saloon is the centre of town.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_nutrient_replicator_desc:
A vast replication device capable of producing nutrients from a wide range of material.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_offworld_tsunkate_desc:
A local Tsunkatse arena brings together fighters from nearby worlds for spectacular events. Touring groups of the finest Tsunkatse fighters also visit, competing in local games and bringing a personal touch to each audience.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Branch Office.
building_omega_facility_2_desc:
Upgraded from the Polaric Ion facilities, the Omega facilities utilise omega molecules synthesised using boronite ore which could, if contained successfully, power an entire civilisation. It is however important to note that omega molecules are notoriously unstable and could potentially destroy light years of space around the point of explosion.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Power Plant.
building_omega_reactor_desc:
A powerhouse of technological prowess, harnesses the intricacies of boronite synthesis. Through intricate engineering, this reactor epitomises the fusion of matter and energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_orbital_capital_1_desc:
This building is the central orbital government building. It is now used as a central headquarters for the habitat itself. The first buildings will no doubt prosper if they stay close to the administrative heart of the habitat.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_organ_storage_facility_desc:
A storage facility for replacement organ containers, allowing for a healthy and productive population.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Amenity Building.
building_organic_holding_pens_desc:
Bioworlds are inhospitable to non-fluidic life. The Organic holding pens allow captured organic life to survive within the Fluidic Realm.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_penal_capital_2_desc:
Prédios fortemente blindados e seguros compõe a sede um uma colônia penal, onde prisioneiros e escravos podem ser monitorados e controlados de uma distância segura.

Sede Priosional I

building_penal_capital_rure_2_desc:
Localizado em um mundo de gelo, a abominável prisão Rura Penthe é amplamente conhecida como o cemitério de aliens, devido ao fato que a expectativa de vida para um prisioneiro é de, no máximo, um ano.

Rura Penthe Penal HQ
building_penal_slave_colony_2_desc:
O controle de todas as instalações penais e oficinas passa por essa administração, a qual realizada vigilância e controle de portas na instalação.

Administração do Superintendente
building_penal_slave_colony_3_desc:
Contenção de campo de força e bloqueio manual da asa do prisioneiro podem ser controlados por este grande prédio administrativo. Prisioneiros podem ser processados com mais eficiência agora.

Administração do Superintendente II
building_penal_slave_colony_4_desc:
Biometria individual dos prisioneiros e rastreamento podem ser alcançados neste largo prédio da administração superintendente. Monitorar a saúde dos prisioneiros é vitalmente importante para garantir a máxima produção de escravos.

Administração do Superintendente III
building_penal_slave_colony_5_desc:
Um complexo administrativo gigante permite, a nível planetário, o processamento, rastreamento, atriguição e encarceiração de diversos presos políticos e outros indesejáveis.

Administração do Superintendente IV
building_pergium_mine_1_desc:
Pergium is a radioactive element that is used as a source of energy, and requires properly protected mining equipment to safely remove from the surface of a world.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_pergium_power_plant_1_desc:
With the discovery of advanced Pergium refining techniques, we are now able to create power plants that utilise this powerful yet relatively safe radioactive element. Sitting atop existing deposits of Pergium, these resource-hungry stations are capable of generating more power than the more timid and conventional fusion reactors.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_pharma_factory_1_desc:
The vast array of medicinal herbs and plants in the area allows for large pharmaceutical facilities to be built which can process the natural medicines into more potent synthetic medicines, such as cordrazine.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_planetary_inhibitor_1_desc:
The power requirements to neutralise warp fields within local space are massive, and require the energy resources of an region to operate effectively. The disruptions in warp bubbles allow for enemy fleets to be pulled from warp within range of the planet, giving time for local defence forces to engage their opponents before they can escape.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_inhibitor_1_tholian_d:
The power requirements to neutralise warp fields within local space are massive, and require the energy resources of an region to operate effectively. The disruptions in warp bubbles by the projected web allow for enemy fleets to be pulled from warp within range of the planet, giving time for local defence forces to engage their opponents before they can escape.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_1_desc:
This system of disguised bunkers and safehouses, connected by a network of self-powered transporters, allows for rapid redeployment of troops and advanced guerilla tactics.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_2_desc:
Using a combination of low-orbit military satellites, surface to air missile defenses, superior construction methods and reactive armor plating to existing military installations, this integrated system hardens all planetary infrastructure against space-borne bombardments and attacks.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_3_desc:
Planetary Shields, a technology that was previously impractical due to energy concerns, are now a feasible reality thanks to advances in power production and predictive virtual intelligence (VI). Numerous surface generators act as 'focus points' for the protective web that envelops the planet, while a sophisticated VI allocates power to the generators that require it most quickly, based on incoming fire. In theory, this system can only be overcome by an orbital bombardment involving a fleet of enormous proportions.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_planetary_shield_4_desc:
We have now managed to combine our planetary shield with a cloaking device to offer, not only protection, but also camouflage. The protection of the planetary field makes targeting the surface almost impossible.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_polaric_ion_1_desc:
A highly-volatile form of energy based on polaric ion particles. Although polaric ions are capable of generating power on a large scale, polaric ion devices were prone to subspace chain reactions. Due to the dangers associated with this energy source, many do not like to live on planets with these stations.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
building_police_1_desc:
Some citizens do not share the same ideals as our leaders, and can cause unrest. The construction of a justice and policing system where these undesirables can be rounded up and detained is important.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_2_desc:
Not every criminal has to remain an undesirable forever. With additional funding allocated to training and rehabilitating these citizens we can improve the wellbeing of the entire planet. The additional funding also improves general security around the planet, with surveillance and scanning equipment being installed to prevent crimes.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_3_desc:
Advances in medical research, called psychotectics, allow for procedures that can be used to 'adjust' the psychological profile of damaged, deviant or otherwise irredeemable citizens. The psychotectic rehabilitation centre allows citizens to undergo treatments to further decrease deviant behaviour on this world.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_4_desc:
The ability to predict a crime before it occurs has long been a dream of law enforcement. The installation of psionic scanners that detect deviant behaviour across the planet will allow our police force to intercept most crimes before they even occur. The courts can then determine whether or not the citizens are guilty of a thought crime, even if it did not occur.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_1_desc:
The cohesion of the Collective is important, and equilibrium depots can ensure areas with low cohesion are able to operate at full efficiency.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_2_desc:
Balancing the cohesion of the Collective alongside autonomous processes can sometimes result in errant behaviour. This can be stabilised by regular equilibrium nodes, which correct errant drones quickly.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_3_desc:
Large facilities with a higher volume of drones can occasionally become hives of errant behaviour, which must be corrected for the good of the Collective. These segments allow for errant drone behaviour to be captured and repaired before further damage to the Collective cohesion is done.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_police_hive_4_desc:
The cohesion of the Collective is important, and large equilibrium complexes are designed to ensure cohesion, and rectify any errant drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.

Então Kahless apontou para uma estrela e disse, 'Procurem por mim lá, naquele ponto de luz' - the Story of the Promise

building_religious_capital_vulcan_2_desc:
Um lugar de paz e tranquilidade, onde muitos Vulcanos mediam e refletem seu caminho. Entretanto, deve haver uma posição de escuta abaixo...

Monastério P'Jem
building_research_lab_4_desc:
The Interstellar Data Storage Network coordinates the work of individual Planetary Data Storages. It is the pinnacle of the data storage technology using sophisticated quantum stream-computation technology. It is able to provide data distribution to the entire population of inhabited planets, starships and starbases.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_resort_1_desc:
The outstanding natural beauty of this location is a massive draw for visitors from all over the galaxy. A resort where species can enjoy this fine attraction will allow this planet to become extremely prosperous.
